title: Altogether Different T-shirt
slide_intent: Give a garment a readable identity without letting a slogan compete with its wearer.
strategic_value: The small mark and compact positioning phrase can extend Channel 4’s voice into merchandise.
demonstration: An overhead photograph shows a black T-shirt with a green 4 on one side and small white Altogether Different lettering on the other.
practical_value: Compare the separation of symbol and phrase on a wearable surface.

content_islands.name: Garment graphics
content_islands.spec: Keep the small green symbol and white phrase on opposite chest areas.

content_islands.name: Handling context
content_islands.spec: Retain the hand and paving around the garment to establish physical scale.

reference_purposes.Application: The logo and positioning phrase are applied to a black T-shirt.
